reviews.snippet: The guys don't give glasses you buy plastic glasses. No regular water served. The dishes are average. It has an open kitchen so you see your food prepared. Two wheelers drive in. Limited variety liquor served. Wash basin located adjacent to toilet. No western commode. Only Indian vommode spacious. For weak and heavy people no railing provided to help in sitting and standing up. The place has a rustic and well ventilated feeling with mini huts. You pay for everything except tissue paper. The service is cordial and to the point. Definitely a good joint to let your hair down. Park your cars on the main road and walk the fifty steps.
